summary: Clean. Format widening matches D-1 exactly (five new triples only; messages unchanged; stored instead taken from the validated input); tag.json and calling-station.json still parse to their exported styles. decideManiac follows D-4/A-2: one draw only when a deviation applies (including capped views), none otherwise, instead -> legal call -> advice move. Probed: all-Maniac 6-max, 150 hands -> 0 invariant violations, 0 illegal actions in 2886 decisions, 13 uncapped no-raise spots (REQ-016.5 / short stack) correctly fell back to the legal call. Heads-up isn't reachable (6-max chart throws for 2 seats, pre-existing). Tests are non-vacuous: Examples A-G pinned with seeds/draws; capped stub-0 loop covers fold-advice caps (kills an advice-move fallback); draw-count stubs kill skip-draw-when-illegal; noBet case kills an unconditional call fallback; SPEC-10's flop view differs from TAG at seeds 12345/4294967295 and SPEC-06 pins raise 12 vs call 4. SPEC-07 recorded deviation is sound: postflop/call/<other> is itself unsupported and reports the unsupported message before the duplicate check, so the different-instead duplicate can only be shown with preflop/fold (raise, call); the same-instead postflop/call duplicate is also tested. Playtest SHA re-run: aacd5e94...e01 (unchanged). 762 vs 750 lines (+1.6%) is the 427-line locked acceptance file; not a concern.
